steps.what: Read the brief for this original literary piece
Decide the subject and the form of the piece
Write original literary pieces for this place

tasks.design: She reads the brief, chooses the subject and the form, and writes the piece in {DOCS}. No draft is produced. A later submission to a journal sits outside these shares.
tasks.previous_blocker: The piece is unstructured creation, so there was no separable clerical slice to take out of the writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new makes the sentences themselves shorter. The piece is still the work.
tasks.still_hard: Subject, form and the sentences have no rule that can stand in for her.
tasks.human_edge: The piece is hers. Subject, form and the sentences stay with her.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still writes the piece, and she gains no decision right she did not already have.

reach.task: Decide whether to print a literary piece
reach.learn: The subject and the sentences stay with the teacher. This task does not hand the editor a generated draft.

evidence.claim: An original literary piece is the work itself, so a generated draft would replace the task rather than shorten a separable step.

assumptions: No structured input is required, because nothing is generated.
A later journal submission is outside these shares. She does not store a second copy here.
Upkeep hours are zero because no draft means no exception queue.
unknowns: Whether a publisher later asks her to submit the piece is outside this task and only she can say if that ask exists.
research_questions: Does this teacher submit the piece to a journal inside this same task, or later?

incremental.description: No draft is produced, so there is no exception queue. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of original pieces is still written by her. No step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero whether the brief is one page or a book.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Act as advisers to student organizations.

steps.what: Read the student organization's last stated aim
Act as advisers to student organizations
Decide which request from the organization she declines

tasks.design: Advising stays in the room. She reads the organisation's last stated aim in {DOCS}, acts as adviser to the student organization, and decides which request to decline. No note of the meeting is kept.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice depends on what the officers say in the room, which is not a form that can be filled ahead of the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new shortens the conversation. Advising stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: The request changes as they talk, and only she can hear what they actually want.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the request and decides which one to decline.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still advises in the room, and she gains no decision right she did not already have.

reach.task: Bring the organisation's request to the adviser
reach.learn: A blank aim is stated in the room. The teacher does not keep a separate note of the meeting.

evidence.claim: Advising a student organization is the conversation in the room, so a generated note would not shorten the meeting.

assumptions: If the last stated aim is blank, the officers say it in the room during the advising conversation.
A later written note to the organisation is outside these shares. The talk is with colleagues in the room, so it is not an external send.
Upkeep hours are zero because no note is kept and there is no exception queue.
unknowns: Whether this organisation later expects a written note is something only the officers and the teacher can confirm.
research_questions: Does advising this student organization include a written note the officers keep, or only the meeting?

incremental.description: No note is kept, so there is no exception queue. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of student-organization meetings stays in the room. No step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero for a short aim or a long dispute.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write grant proposals to procure external research funding.

steps.what: Read the call headings and the named research publications
State the aim, method, budget lines, and publications for the grant
Draft grant proposals from the aim and method she stated
Check the draft states her aim and method and adds no claim
Send the accepted grant proposal through the funder portal to procure the funding

tasks.design: She states the aim, method, budget lines and publication titles. A fixed copy places only those fields under the call headings in {DOCS} and does not wait to be checked. She checks that no heading gained a claim, and only the accepted proposal is sent once through the funder portal {OTHER}. A rejection sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The proposal was treated as one write, so copying stated fields into fixed headings was not split from the science.
tasks.enabler_now: The call headings are a fixed list. Copying stated fields into them needs no model and adds no sentence.
tasks.still_hard: The aim and the method are hers. A call whose headings do not match those fields cannot be filled by the copy.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the aim and the method, and she rejects a heading that gained a claim.
tasks.altitude: Heading assembly and the portal send leave her week. She still states the aim and method, and she still accepts or rejects the proposal before it is sent.

reach.task: Read the grant proposal that was sent
reach.learn: The aim and method are the teacher's. A heading that gained a claim is not in the sent proposal.

evidence.claim: Copying a stated aim, method, budget lines and named publications into a funder's headings is assembly and adds no claim.
Referees may not use generative AI; uploading a proposal breaches confidentiality.

assumptions: Structured input for the draft: aim (one sentence), method (one sentence), budget lines (name and amount), publication titles (title plus record id). She states them before the copy. The publication list starts from her research record; if that list is blank she types the titles in that stating step, and this task does not rebuild the record.
If the aim is blank, no draft is made. The copy places only the stated fields under the call headings. It does not compose new sentences and it does not wait for its own check.
The proposal is not uploaded to an external model. The funder portal is {OTHER}. A change to the draft voids the acceptance. A rejection sends nothing, and she does not type a second copy.
Upkeep hours are zero because a rejected heading is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue.
unknowns: Which extra fields this funder's portal requires beyond aim, method, budget lines and publication titles.
research_questions: Which funder portal fields are mandatory beyond aim, method, budget lines and publication titles?

already_counted.description: The meaning check of the draft, already counted in the review step before the send.

incremental.description: A rejected heading is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year of calls whose headings rarely match, so she often rejects and the send rarely fires. High: a year of calls whose headings match her stated fields, so the copy and the one send happen, while the aim, the method and the meaning check stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review manuscripts for publication in professional journals.

steps.what: Read the journal questions for these manuscripts
Review manuscripts for publication in professional journals
List citations that do not resolve in the library catalogue
Check a missing record is not stated as a found citation
Write the publication recommendation from her own marks

tasks.design: She reads the manuscript and makes her own marks in {DOCS}. A lookup on the library catalogue {OTHER} lists citations that do not resolve. She checks that a missing record is not stated as found, then writes the publication recommendation from her own marks, using only citations she accepted. The recommendation is not sent from this task and is not stored by a second step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Citation checks sat inside the reading, so the lookup was not split from the judgement of the manuscript.
tasks.enabler_now: A catalogue can say whether a title and a record id resolve, without judging the manuscript.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the argument holds, and what to recommend, stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: The publication recommendation is hers. A catalogue match does not decide merit.
tasks.altitude: Hand lookup of citations leaves her week. She still reads the manuscript and still writes the recommendation.

reach.learn: An unresolved citation is not stated as found. The recommendation is the teacher's, and this task does not send it.

evidence.claim: Checking whether a citation resolves to a catalogue record is a lookup. The publication recommendation stays her judgement.
Invented references pass plagiarism checks unflagged.

assumptions: A citation is a title plus a record id. The library catalogue ({OTHER}) produces the resolve result. The lookup does not judge merit and does not replace a citation.
If the catalogue is down, the citation is listed unresolved and she does not look it up later. If the journal questions are blank, she reads the argument without them.

She writes the recommendation only from citations she accepted after the check. Sending the recommendation to the editor is a later message and is outside these shares. This task does not store a second copy.
Upkeep hours are zero because an unresolved citation stays on the list. There is no later lookup queue.
unknowns: Which catalogue she is allowed to query with the references of an unpublished manuscript.
research_questions: Which catalogue may this teacher query while a manuscript is still unpublished?

already_counted.description: The check that a missing record is not stated as a found citation, already counted in that review step.

incremental.description: If the catalogue is down, the citation stays unresolved. She does not look it up later, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year of one short note whose few citations she already knows, so the lookup rarely changes the hour. High: a year of long manuscripts whose references she now checks by hand. Reading and the recommendation stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The literary piece, the advising conversation, the grant's aim and method, and the review judgement stay in her week. Heading assembly of a grant and hand lookup of citations leave it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: State the grant's aim and method before any draft is made.
Reject a proposal heading that gained a claim.
Reject a review citation that does not resolve in the catalogue.
Leave the literary piece and the student meeting in her own words.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take on more pieces, more organisations, more calls or more manuscripts because of this.
